scope: Construction of one explicitly selected shallow reinforced-concrete shaft water-intake well WIW-RC-DN2000-18M, 18 m deep and 2000 mm internal diameter, with 20 KS20.9 lining rings, 65 m bentonite joint seal, two 15 m3/h submersible pumps, 30 m OD63 discharge pipe and one PP20-2 cover slab. Excavation, base filter, sanitary seal, headworks, electrical-controls, cleaning, testing, labor, mechanisms and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved hydrogeological project for a shallow water-intake well, shaft and lining drawings, precast-ring and joint-seal schedules, base-filter detail, pump duty calculation, sanitary-zone detail, electrical-control drawings, pumping-test program, laboratory requirements, suppliers and approving project engineer

conditionalBranches.excavationShoring: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved temporary-works design requires it
conditionalBranches.groundwaterDewatering: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved method statement requires it beyond the direct construction pumping allowance
conditionalBranches.temporaryAccess: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved site plan requires it

exclusions: deep drilled production borehole casing and screen quantities
external distribution network, clean-water reservoir, treatment plant and sewerage
depth-derived lining, filter, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities
unapproved groundwater, temporary works, materials, equipment or prices
